patterns.message: The decider kit imports effect and its own files only.

The kernel domain fence: the kernel's domain files import effect, @dotfiles/decider/*, the kernel's own root files and bun:test only; never @opencode/*, node:*, bun, a vendor package or one of the kernel's folders.

The pool domain fence: the pool's domain files import effect, @dotfiles/decider/*, the pool's own root files and bun:test only; never @opencode/*, node:*, bun, a vendor package or one of the pool's folders.

The orchestrate domain fence: orchestrate's domain files import effect, @dotfiles/decider/*, orchestrate's own root files (and the generated agents.json) and bun:test only; never @opencode/*, node:*, bun, a vendor package or one of orchestrate's folders.

The status domain fence: status's domain files import effect, @dotfiles/decider/*, status's own root files and bun:test only; never @opencode/*, node:*, bun, a vendor package or one of status's folders.
The status UI fence: the pane's components import the status domain, never an implementation (filestore/, process/, memory/).

The herdr domain fence: the herdr reporter's domain files import effect, @dotfiles/decider/*, its own root files and bun:test only; never @opencode/*, node:*, bun, a vendor package or one of its folders.
The guard domain fence: the guard's domain files import effect, the guard's own root files and bun:test only; never @opencode/*, node:*, bun, a vendor package or one of the guard's folders.

The subagents fence: the row model is plain TypeScript over a plain view; its root files import each other and bun:test only, never effect, @opencode/*, @opentui/*, solid-js, node:*, bun or its opencode/ folder.
The subagents reader fence: opencode/ reads the TUI's data through its own narrowed Reads, so it imports the model's root files, its own files and bun:test only; never @opencode/* or a renderer.
The git domain fence: git's domain files import effect, git's own root files and bun:test only; never @opencode/*, node:*, bun, a vendor package or one of git's folders.
The git UI fence: the sidebar and the pane import the git domain, never an implementation (process/, opencode/) or the laws; every read goes through the git RPC.

The queue domain fence: the queue's domain files import effect, @dotfiles/decider/*, the shared subagent rows' root files (@dotfiles/opencode-subagents/*, not its opencode/ reader), their own root files and bun:test only; never @opencode/*, node:*, bun, a vendor package or one of its folders.
The queue UI fence: the sidebar section imports the queue domain and the TUI's data reader (opencode/), never a store (filestore/, memory/).
